newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks close higher, outlook cautious.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks close higher, outlook cautious.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed higher on Tuesday but were off intraday highs after Wall Street's weakness at the open.
The general index rose 1.25 points, 0.36 percent, to 352.14 and the Ibex added 15.83 points, 0.4 percent, to 4,003.71.

Telefonica overturned early gains to fall 5 pesetas to 2,345 amid reports that the firm is interested in buying the state's stake in its international unit. Dealers were cautious on the deal until when, if at all, any price tag is put on it.
Oil firm Repsol was up 20 pesetas to 4,100 after news of a cut in its petrol prices, interpreted positively, dealers said.
In general, there was some room for optimism.
"Leaving the short term aside, the market has more reasons to rise than to fall and as soon as some good news starts to appear we'll see new money coming in" said a trader at Oddo.
Investors are awaiting August inflation data as well as concrete details on the 1997 budget before the bourse can steam ahead, dealers said.
